aboutLocales.zh:
关于 CodexFlow

CodexFlow 诞生于一个简单的想法：让 Codex 的使用体验更流畅、更优雅。
aboutLocales.en:
About CodexFlow

CodexFlow began with a simple idea: make interacting with Codex smoother and more elegant.

latest.notes:
1. 实现完整内置 Git 面板能力，在标签栏左侧打开
2. 历史详情支持预览图片、查看大图和右键复制
3. 历史侧边栏新增“当前项目 / 项目组 / 全部会话”三档范围切换
4. 长历史详情支持全量虚拟列表读取
5. 支持从子工作区继续创建新的工作区
6. 删除对话框支持按目标分支进行重置
7. 支持通过 Ctrl + Home / Ctrl + End 快捷键快速跳转至终端或历史详情的顶部/底部，并增加可见快捷按钮，便于快速跳转
8. 历史详情支持一键跳转至上一条/下一条用户输入会话
9. 支持独立标签页窗口
10. 运行中代理的标签数字增加动效提示，并在标签页中展示代理运行状态
11. 关闭标签页前增加弹窗提醒；输入框中仍有内容时，关闭前进行二次确认
12. 修复 Gemini 长消息发送失败问题
13. 优化 Gemini 的图片传递能力
14. 优化 Codex 滚动条自动跳回顶部的问题

notesLocales.en:
1. Added a full built-in Git panel that opens from the left side of the tab bar
2. History details now support image preview, large-image viewing, and right-click copy
3. Added a three-level scope switch in the history sidebar: Current Project / Project Group / All Sessions
4. Long history details now support full virtual-list loading
5. Supports creating a new workspace from a child workspace
6. The delete dialog now supports resetting by target branch
7. Supports Ctrl + Home / Ctrl + End shortcuts to quickly jump to the top or bottom of the terminal or history details, with visible shortcut buttons added for easier navigation
8. History details now support one-click navigation to the previous/next user input
9. Supports independent tab windows
10. Running agent tab numbers now include animated indicators, and tabs display the agent running state
11. Closing a tab now shows a confirmation dialog; if the input box still contains content, an additional confirmation is shown before closing
12. Fixed Gemini long-message sending failures
13. Improved Gemini image transfer behavior
14. Fixed the issue where the Codex scrollbar automatically jumped back to the top
